'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Chris Gogolen LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Gogolen]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Yep, I'm that lazy.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
